description: Import Wise transaction-history CSV rows. Direct-call contract: DRY RUN by default; execute=true creates rows; each created bank row carries the API type of its true direction (incoming IN → type D, outgoing OUT → type C) and source_direction records that same flow; fees are separate outgoing (type C) transactions; inter-account transfers avoid double-counting confirmed counterpart journals.

accounts_dimensions_id.description: Bank account dimension ID for the Wise account in e-arveldaja. Must be the dimension of a configured bank account; otherwise refused with wise_dimension_not_bank_account before any write.

acknowledged_journal_holds.description: Owner-confirmed only: { wise_id, journal_ids } stating those journals do NOT book that held Wise transfer. Releases the row (imported and confirmed normally; an exact-label double-booking hold stays recorded as booked by its labelled journal) only when journal_ids lists every required_acknowledgement_ids journal of its review; never for counterpart, identity or untagged-row holds.

approved_command_digest.description: Exact lowercase SHA-256 command digest returned by the reviewed dry run. Required for execute=true when mutations are planned.

confirm_own_transfer_ids.description: Exact Wise IDs explicitly approved as own transfers. TRANSFER-* and BANK_DETAILS_PAYMENT_RETURN-* prefixes are hints only.

counterpart_overrides.description: Owner-confirmed only: { wise_id, dimension_id } picking the own bank account a transfer row goes to or from when its own-account evidence points to several (wise_transfer_counterpart_conflict). The pick must be one of the evidenced accounts, else the row stays held; an entry that decides nothing is reported (unused_counterpart_override).

date_from.description: Only import transactions from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

date_to.description: Only import transactions up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

execute.description: Actually create transactions (default false = dry run)

fee_account_dimensions_id.description: Account dimension ID for the Wise fee expense account.

file_path.description: Absolute path/base64 Wise CSV input. Provide exactly one of file_path or file_ref.

file_ref.description: Opaque Accounting Inbox Wise CSV reference. Provide exactly one of file_path or file_ref.

inter_account_dimension_id.description: Other bank account dimension ID for inter-account transfers. Auto-detected if only one other bank account exists. Per row, own-account evidence on another bank decides first and this id is the fallback; a row whose counterpart cannot be determined or whose evidence contradicts this id is held (not imported), the other rows are planned.

journalized_transfer_ids.description: Exact { wise_id, journal_id } pairs the operator has checked: the labelled inter-account journal already books that Wise transfer (resolves a wise_transfer_journal_ambiguous review). Each mapping is validated; a rejected one is reported and the row resolves as if unmapped (it may still be skipped as already journalized, or held for review).

plan_handle.description: Execution-plan handle returned by the reviewed dry run. Required for execute=true in addition to approved_command_digest; the digest alone cannot execute.

skip_jar_transfers.description: Skip Jar (savings pot) transfers — internal movements within Wise (default true)

name: import_wise_transactions
title: Import Wise Transactions
